title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingTask
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingTask. Single step or a combination of multiple steps in which waste is handled via mechanical, chemical, thermal or biological processes with the aim of recovering material or energetic value and/or reducing the volume and environmental impact of the waste (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.1.3.19). Subclass of saref:Task (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.18); saref:Task is SAREF Core, out of this candidate's scope. Base class for s4envi:WastePreTreatmentTask, s4envi:WasteTreatmentTask and s4envi:WasteDisposalTask.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteProcessingTask'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
